propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling at 32767 characters, ignoring Jira Data Center's admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property which can range from 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647
when a DC administrator raises or removes the comment limit, rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept, causing undetected data loss on the remote instance
the comment sanitizer reuses the description text fitter, creating a structural trap where future changes to description fitting could unintentionally retarget comment truncation
the DC comment ceiling is now configurable via ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars with environment override REBAR_RECONCILER_COMMENT_MAX_CHARS, defaulting to 32767 per JRASERVER-28519
the application-properties endpoint is admin-only on DC 8.17.1 and unreadable by rebar's ordinary-user PAT, making auto-discovery infeasible
